description: This file defines the Drupal 'Datelist' form element class, including methods for rendering, processing, and validating date list inputs within Drupal forms.

classes.name: Datelist
classes.description: Provides a Drupal form element for selecting date lists, with methods for rendering, processing, and validation.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties and settings for the datelist form element.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Processes and validates the input date, adjusting for AM/PM and creating a DrupalDateTime object.

methods.name: processDatelist
methods.description: Expands a date object into individual form elements for date parts, handling default values and callbacks.

methods.name: validateDatelist
methods.description: Validates the date input, ensuring completeness and correctness, and sets errors if invalid.

methods.name: checkEmptyInputs
methods.description: Checks for empty date part inputs in the submitted form data.

methods.name: incrementRound
methods.description: Rounds minutes and seconds of a DrupalDateTime object to the nearest specified increment.
